file_reviews.assessment: Audited Paper 005 guide sections covering discrete L1 projection semantics, standalone companion layout, native functional delegation, and relational completeness gating.

Audited Paper 005 claim ledger rows G005-10 (standalone companion and vendored provenance), G005-11 (native refusal propagation and exact enumeration), G005-12 (CUT completeness), and G005-13 (harness exact inputs).
Audited native graph transport adapter compute_graph_phi1, provenance metadata headers binding upstream commit 52cb5457f6c4, and fail-closed exception paths.

Audited L1SymbolGameGovernor compute_phi1 exception propagation and exact enumeration fallback, step_cut completeness check enforcing exact values on declared edges, and provenance headers binding commit 691a01ec3e0e and baseline 52cb5457f6c4.
Audited SymbolGameStreamingSession turn execution, StreamingEnvelopeParser, and isinstance(val, (bool, float)) pre-conversion guard in run_turn emitting FW-OP_Refusal.
Audited vendored module header checks, AST unpatched equivalence tests, step_cut completeness check presence test, and compute_phi1 exception handler absence test.
Audited native refusal propagation test suite verifying configured native failure propagation, unconfigured spanning forest potential enumeration, and float/bool weight refusal.
Audited regression tests for R008-04 verifying refusal of empty proposals, proposals omitting declared edges, and non-exact value proposals with state unchanged.
Audited streaming harness exact input tests verifying FW-OP_Refusal on float and bool claim values and defect scoring for exact integers and rational strings.

claims.statement: The Python companion runs outside the repository, and its copied adapter and governor match the recorded sources up to the documented patches.
dependencies: Vendored metadata headers declaring source path, commit, and SHA-256 in native_functional.py and l1_symbol_game_governor.py.
AST normalization stripping excised bootstrap helpers (_find_repo_root, _REPO_ROOT) and remapping module imports.
Documented behavioral patches in compute_phi1, step_cut, step_assert, and step_verify.
claims.limits: Confirms structural AST equivalence outside documented patches; native binary solver execution is separately required.

claims.statement: compute_phi1 propagates a configured native failure, enumerates exactly when unconfigured, and refuses float/Boolean weights.
dependencies: Delegation to compute_graph_phi1 when CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_BIN is configured without an enclosing exception handler.
Spanning-forest exact rational potential enumeration fallback when CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_BIN is unconfigured.
Exact type guards enforcing type(weight) in (int, Fraction) and type(value) in (int, Fraction).
claims.limits: Describes the patched governor copy; Python spanning-forest enumeration results are not native execution results.

claims.statement: A relational CUT missing a declared edge or with a non-exact value raises IncompleteProposal with state unchanged.
dependencies: Declared edge key inventory check declared = [e.key for e in self.graph.edges].
Completeness predicate identifying missing keys or non-exact value types in proposed_claims.
Atomic refusal emission with status IncompleteProposal leaving edge_claims and primary_obstruction unchanged.
claims.limits: Applies to relational CUT proposals; syntactic completeness check does not imply factual domain accuracy of replacement claims.

claims.statement: The streaming harness refuses float and Boolean claim values and scores integers and exact rational strings.
dependencies: Type-guard check isinstance(val, (bool, float)) in run_turn prior to Fraction conversion.
Governor Python evaluation of exact rational claims.
claims.limits: Evaluated on MockLLMStreamingProposer; does not measure live LLM token completion distributions or API network latency.
